questions: How do I capture an idea?
The app opens in the Nebula. Enter text at the bottom or hold a planet to record audio. On a regular planet, new ideas are saved there. The recent-records button opens a searchable timeline.
What's the difference between planets, stars and the Nebula?

Planets hold projects with a goal; stars hold ongoing themes. The Nebula is your inbox. Planet names and descriptions help online organization identify a suitable home. You can also move records yourself.
Why is an idea still in the Nebula or waiting to be organized?

Ideas stay there when no planet fits, confidence is low or the network is unavailable. Successfully saved text remains local. Reconnect and keep the app in the foreground to retry pending or failed organization. You can accept or ignore destination suggestions individually.
What if a recording isn't transcribed?

Check microphone and speech-recognition permissions in system settings and the app's transcription language. The app tries on-device recognition first and may fall back to Apple's online recognition, which needs a connection. Failed transcription keeps the recording; retry from the record menu.

Use the same Apple Account on both devices, allow iCloud for the app, and check connectivity and storage. Check iCloud account status in the app and reopen both devices later. An available account doesn't mean transfers are complete. Keep capturing locally while offline; don't delete the app or clear data to troubleshoot.
Where are related ideas, key points and theme suggestions?

Find related ideas in record details. Longer text and transcripts offer an extract-key-points action. The Nebula starts discovering themes after at least three eligible records, and creating a planet requires confirmation. Results depend on connectivity and content and don't overwrite the original.
How do I edit, move or delete records?

Open a record to edit it. Move and retranscribe actions are in its menu. A brief undo prompt follows deletion. iCloud also syncs edits and deletions. Project ideas can be marked completed; theme and Nebula ideas can be marked as favorites.
How do I restore purchases or cancel a subscription?

Open the membership screen from app settings and restore purchases with the Apple Account used to buy. Pending purchases unlock after Apple confirms them. Prices and benefits are shown in the app. Manage or cancel subscriptions through Apple's subscription management page.
privacy: Their data paths should be clear.
Original text and audio are saved on your device first. Sync, speech recognition and online AI have separate data paths.
sections: This notice covers Evolution Studio's InspirPlanet app and these product, support and privacy pages. It describes the current implementation. Last updated: October 2, 2026.

Planets, original text, audio, tags, keywords, priorities and record states are stored on your device. When iCloud is available, CloudKit's private database syncs them, including deletions, between devices on the same Apple Account. Appearance, haptic and transcription-language preferences stay local. We have no operator dashboard for browsing your private CloudKit records. Apple operates and processes data for its cloud services.

Recording requires microphone permission; transcription requires speech-recognition permission. Audio is saved locally and can sync with its record through iCloud. Transcription tries on-device recognition first, then may fall back to Apple's online recognition, sending audio to Apple. Transcribed text may enter the online AI workflow below. Manage these permissions in system settings.

After a record is saved or edited, original text, candidate keywords and existing planet information, including names, types and descriptions, go to our Cloudflare Worker and through OpenRouter to model services for organization. Jev handles organization; DeepSeek currently handles related ideas, themes and key points. Requests include relevant record identifiers, creation times and destination information. Supported Apple Intelligence devices can extract additional words on device. Disabling this enhancement does not stop online organization. Online AI is not entirely local.

Related-idea lookup first selects candidates locally, then sends the current and relevant candidate text for review; automatic linking can be disabled. Key-point extraction is user-triggered and sends that record's text. Theme discovery automatically sends up to 24 selected Nebula records and existing planet information when eligible; creation requires your confirmation. Planet recaps also call related-idea and summary services in the foreground with recent and older candidate text; disabling recap notifications does not stop generation. Only the latest recap is kept locally. Other derived results are cached locally for usually seven days, invalidated by edits or deletion, and can be cleared in settings.

Cloudflare processes requests and OpenRouter routes input to model providers. Our Worker does not log original idea text, audio or provider keys; failures log only error status. IP addresses and network metadata are involved in request processing, rate limiting and troubleshooting. Infrastructure and model providers may process or retain data under their policies. We do not promise universal zero retention or no training use, and processing may occur outside your region.

Apple StoreKit handles purchases. The app reads verified transactions and subscription entitlements; we do not receive full payment-card details. These pages include no advertising tracking, analytics scripts or tracking cookies. Appearance preferences use browser local storage; this does not send idea content. Hosting may process IP addresses, request paths and error logs. Old-idea and recap reminders are local system notifications. Exporting or sharing sends selected text, planet images and optional signatures to your chosen app or recipient. Email providers process the address, message and attachments you send to support; we use them to respond and troubleshoot.

You can edit, move or delete records and manage permissions, iCloud, on-device enhancement and automatic linking. Deletion clears related derived caches and syncs when enabled. Uninstalling does not necessarily delete iCloud data or cancel Apple subscriptions; manage those through Apple's storage and subscription controls. Online organization has no separate off switch. Offline capture avoids sending text while offline; reconnecting with the app in the foreground may send pending records.
Ask about processing, make privacy requests or report issues at louis.chenluodeng@gmail.com. Provide only the information needed. We update this notice and its date when features or providers change.

product.title: Capture, organize, and follow through.
product.body: InspirPlanet is an idea notebook for iPhone. Type a thought or hold a planet to record your voice. Ideas are saved locally first; online AI then organizes tags, keywords, priority and planet placement. Planets hold goal-driven projects, stars hold ongoing interests, and the Nebula holds unsorted thoughts. Find related ideas, extract key points from long text, confirm suggested theme planets, and mark project ideas as done. iCloud can sync planets, text and audio across devices using the same Apple Account.

steps: Use a lock-screen widget, Control Center or a configured Action Button to open text capture. Prefer speaking? Open the app and hold a planet. Text and audio save on your device first.
Ideas don’t need to pile up in a long document or a chat with yourself. Each has its own note to edit, search and move. Mark project ideas as done when you bring them to life.
Online AI helps with tags, keywords, priority and placement in your projects or ongoing themes. Unsure ideas stay in the Nebula. You can always adjust their home.
